model.detail: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct serves prompt-based components; method configuration can select a released trained model.

tokenizer.detail: Tokenizer corresponding to the shared model.

encoder.detail: Common dense encoder over question-specific candidate passages.

seeds.detail: Pass the seed to every model request.

temperature.detail: Greedy decoding unless a method specifies a published temperature.

top_p.detail: No nucleus cutoff unless specified by the method.

max_tokens.detail: 512 tokens for a generic control call; method-specific limits take precedence.

answer_max_tokens.detail: 128 tokens for a short final answer; method-specific limits take precedence.

max_context_tokens.detail: 8192 input-plus-output tokens; overflow is recorded as failure, without hidden truncation.

retriever.detail: Dense retrieval by default; BM25 and hybrid workflows retain their configured retrieval modes.

top_k.detail: Five passages where the method does not specify another cutoff.

rrf_k.detail: Rank offset 60 for dense/sparse hybrid scoring.

api_attempts.detail: At most three identical requests for transient connection or server failures.

question_timeout_seconds.detail: 900 seconds per question; all attempted questions remain in the denominator.
